text: Hey! You have POKéMON!\nCome on!\pLet's battle 'em!
Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away.\nAnother time, okay?
Yo!\nYou can't jam out if you're a\pPOKéMON TRAINER!
That totally stinks! I'm going to\ncatch some stronger ones!
Hey, wait up!\nWhat's the hurry? Why the rush?
Sometimes, you can find stuff on\nthe ground.\fI'm looking for the stuff I\ndropped. Can you help me?

¡Eh, espera!
¿Por qué tienes tanta¡Me rindo!
¡¡A veces puedes encontrar cosas
en el suelo! ¡Estoy buscando los objetos
que se me cayeron!
TRAINER TIPS\fIf your POKéMON are weak and you\nwant to avoid battles, stay away\pfrom grassy areas!
For poison, use ANTIDOTE!\nGet it at POKéMON MARTS!
TRAINER TIPS\fContact PROF. OAK via a PC to\nget your POKéDEX evaluated!
TRAINER TIPS\fYou can't catch a POKéMON that\nbelongs to someone else.\fThrow POKé BALLS only at wild\nPOKéMON to catch them!
TRAINER TIPS\fWeaken POKéMON before attempting\ncapture!\fWhen healthy, they may escape!
Wow! It's way bigger in here than\nI thought!
Dicen que aquí hay unos fósiles\nmuy raros.
Hey, stop!\fI found these fossils!\nThey're both mine!
We'll each take a fossil!\nNo being greedy!
All right.\nThen this fossil is mine!
Far away, on CINNABAR ISLAND,\nthere's a POKéMON LAB.\fThey do research on regenerating\nfossils.
We, TEAM ROCKET, shall find the\nfossils!\fReviving POKéMON from them will\nearn us huge riches!
You made me mad!\nTEAM ROCKET will blacklist you!
We, TEAM ROCKET, are POKéMON\ngangsters!\pWe strike fear with our strength!
Darn it all!\nMy associates won't stand for this!
We're pulling a big job here!\nGet lost, kid!
If you find a fossil, give it to me\nand scram!
Little kids shouldn't be messing\naround with grown-ups!\fIt could be bad news!
POKéMON lived here long before\npeople came.
Do you want the DOME FOSSIL?
Do you want the HELIX FOSSIL?

{FD06}: Bonjour!
{FD01}! Imagine seeing you here!
{FD01}, were you really invited? So how's your POKéDEX coming? I already caught 40 kinds, pal.
Different kinds are everywhere. Crawl around in grassy areas, and
look hard for them.

{FD06}: I heard there was a CUT
master on board. But he was just a seasick old man! CUT itself is really useful.
Yup, it'll be handy. You should go see him, too.
Smell ya!
Our CAPTAIN is a sword master.\nHe's awesome at using CUT.\fThey say he even teaches CUT\nto POKéMON!
The party's over.\nThe ship will be departing soon.
Hey, matey!\fLet's do a little jig!
How many kinds of POKéMON do you\nthink there are in this big world?
My pa said there are 100 kinds of\nPOKéMON. I think there are more.
You, mon petit!\nWe're busy here!\pOut of the way!
I saw an odd BERRY in the trash.\nI wonder what that was?
I'm so busy I'm getting dizzy!\nYou have to give me room here!
Did you hear about SNORLAX?\nIt's a glutton.\fNo other POKéMON eats and sleeps\nthe way SNORLAX can and does!
Er-hem!\nIndeed I am le CHEF!\fLe main course is
Salmon du Salad!\fLes guests may gripe it's fish\nagain, however!
Eels au Barbecue!\fLes guests will mutiny, I fear.
Prime Beefsteak!\fBut, have I enough fillets du\nbeef?
Using CUT, you can chop down\nsmall trees.\fWhy not try it with the trees\naround VERMILION CITY?
Oh, no!\nYou have no room for this!
Listen, listen!\nLet me be your friend, okay?\fThen we can trade POKéMON and\ndo stuff.
I collected these POKéMON\nfrom all around the world!
Oh, no!\nI went around the world for these!
You hurt my poor POKéMON!\fI demand that you heal them at a\nPOKéMON CENTER!
We are cruising around the world,\nmy children and I.
A world cruise is so elegant yet\ncozy!
I always travel with WIGGLYTUFF.\nI never leave home without it.
Waiter, I would like a cherry pie,\nplease!
Waitress, I would like a cherry\npie, please!
You insolent pup!\nHow dare you barge in!
Humph! You rude child!\nYou have no sense of courtesy!
I wish to be left alone!\nGet out!
You should be nice to friends!
I've journeyed far and wide, but in\nall my travels I've never seen\pany POKéMON sleep like this one!\fIt was something like this!
Competing against the young keeps\nme youthful.
Good match!\nAh, I feel young again!
Fifteen years ago, I would\nhave won!
Check out what I fished up!
Party?\fThe cruise ship's party should be\nover by now.
Ah, yes, I have seen some POKéMON\nferry people across the water!

Small trees can be chopped down
using the move CUT. But remember this!
CUT is an HM technique. Once learned, it is not so easily
discarded.
Which do you find more worthy,\na strong or a rare POKéMON?
Personally, I prefer strong and\nrare POKéMON.
I don't believe I saw you at the\nparty?
Oh, I adore your strong POKéMON!\nOh, how I envy you for them!
Have you gone to the SAFARI ZONE\nin FUCHSIA CITY?\fThere are many kinds of rare\nPOKéMON.
Me and my daddy think the SAFARI\nZONE is awesome!\pI wish we could go there again.
The CAPTAIN said he's awfully sick.\nHe was all pale.
I hear many people get seasick.
Matey, you're walking the plank if\nyou lose!
When we're out at sea, jellyfish\nPOKéMON sometimes drift by.
Hello, stranger!\fI can't tell if you're from the seas\nor mountains, but stop and chat.\fAll my POKéMON are from the sea.
Darn!\nI let that one get away!
I was going to make you my\nassistant, too!
Even us sailors have POKéMON, too!
We caught all our POKéMON while\nwe were out at sea.
I like feisty kids like you!
Sea POKéMON live in deep water.\nYou'll need a ROD to fish them up!
You know what they say about\nsailors and battling!
Hahaha!\nWant to be a sailor, mate?
Come on, then!\nMy sailor's pride is at stake!
Did you see the FISHING GURU in\nVERMILION CITY?
My buddy MACHOKE is super strong!\fHe has enough STRENGTH to move\nbig rocks!
You look tired. Would you like to\ntake a short rest?
I'm glad to see that everyone is\nlooking refreshed and chipper.
People often lose things in the\ndarkness of the UNDERGROUND PATH.
I heard a sleepy POKéMON appeared\nout near CELADON CITY, too.
The DEPARTMENT STORE in CELADON\nhas a great selection.\fDo you go there very often?
Well, isn't this a surprise!\nDIGLETT dug this long tunnel!\fIt goes right to VIRIDIAN CITY,\nthey tell me.
I wonder if you are good enough\nfor me?
I can see you're good.\nLet me see exactly how good!
Tch!\nI concede, you are better than I!
If you can get through here,\nyou can go meet the ELITE FOUR.
I can beat you when it comes to\nknowledge about POKéMON!
This here is VICTORY ROAD.\nIt's the final test for TRAINERS!
If you get stuck, try moving some\nboulders around.
Ah, so you wish to challenge the\nELITE FOUR?
Many TRAINERS give up their\nchallenge here and go home.

You should be proud of yourself,
having battled your way through\pVICTORY ROAD so courageously. In recognition of your feat,
I'll teach you DOUBLE-EDGE. Would you like me to teach that
technique?
Keep that drive going for the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE!\fTake a run at them and knock 'em\nout!
I heard rumors of a child prodigy.
So, it was you who beat GIOVANNI\nof TEAM ROCKET?
By fighting tough battles, you get\nstronger.
I'll show you just how good you\nare. Not!
Only the chosen can pass here!
All TRAINERS here are headed to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE.\fDon't let down your guard.
RAY: Together, the two of us are\ndestined for greatness!
RAY: Together, the two of us are\nstriving for the pinnacle.\fWe need you to bring two POKéMON\ninto battle with us.
TYRA: We're trying to become\nchampions together.
TYRA: You've taught me that power\ncan be infinite in shape and form.
TYRA: You can't battle with us if\nyou have only one POKéMON.
Who are you?\nHow did you get here?
You broke into TEAM ROCKET's\noperation? What nerve!
You're not going to get away with\nthis, brat!
SILPH SCOPE? Humph!\nI don't know where it is.
Are you lost, you little mouse?
Uh-oh, that ruckus somehow opened\nthe door!
BOSS said you can see ghosts with\nthe SILPH SCOPE.
The TEAM ROCKET HQ has four\nunderground floors.\fThink you can reach the BOSS?
Stop meddling in TEAM ROCKET's\naffairs or else!
SILPH SCOPE?\nOh, that machine the BOSS stole.\fIt's here somewhere.
We got word from upstairs that you\nwere coming!
Go ahead and go!\fBut you can't run the elevator\nwithout the LIFT KEY.

So! I must say, I am impressed you
got here. TEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from
around the world. They're important tools for keeping
our criminal enterprise going. I am the leader, GIOVANNI! For your insolence, you will feel a
world of pain!
I know you!\nYou ruined our plans at MT. MOON!
Do you have something against TEAM\nROCKET?
How can you not see the beauty of\nour evil?
The elevator doesn't work?\nWho has the LIFT KEY?
Oh, no!\nI dropped the LIFT KEY!
It appears to need a key.
Welcome.\fThe PRESIDENT is in the boardroom\non 11F.
How did you know\nI was a ROCKET?
I work for both SILPH and TEAM\nROCKET.
Can you solve the maze in here?\nIt's not easy, I tell you!
No kids are allowed in here!
Diamond-shaped tiles are teleport\nblocks.\fThey're transporters for this\nhigh-tech building.
Hey, kid!\nWhat are you wandering here for?
SILPH CO. will be associated with\nTEAM ROCKET!
Which POKéMON should I teach\nTHUNDER WAVE?

THUNDER WAVE causes paralysis in
the target POKéMON. A paralyzed POKéMON may be unable
to move in battle. It's an ELECTRIC-type move, so it
won't work on some POKéMON.
I work for SILPH CO.\nWhat am I to do?
A hint? You can open doors with\na CARD KEY!
I support TEAM ROCKET more than\nI support SILPH CO.!
TEAM ROCKET has taken control\nof SILPH CO.!
Fwahahaha!\nMy BOSS has been after this place!
My POKéMON is my loyal servant.
The doors are electronically\nlocked.\fIt takes a CARD KEY to open the\ndoors here.
I better tell the BOSS on 11F!
TEAM ROCKET is in an uproar over\nsome intruder.\fThat's you, right?
TEAM ROCKET took off!\nYou're our hero! Thank you!
I heard a kid was wandering\naround.
It's not smart to pick a fight with\nTEAM ROCKET!
We study POKé BALL technology on\nthis floor.
We worked on the ultimate POKé\nBALL which would catch anything.
You're only on 5F.\nIt's a long way to my BOSS!
Show TEAM ROCKET a little respect!
Which reminds me.\fKOFFING evolves into WEEZING!
It's a POKéMON REPORT!\fPOKéMON LAB created PORYGON,\nthe first virtual-reality POKéMON.
It's a POKéMON REPORT!\fOver 350 POKéMON techniques have\nbeen confirmed.
It's a POKéMON REPORT!\fSome POKéMON have been confirmed\nto evolve when they are traded.
The ROCKETS came and took over\nthe building!
Well, better get back to work.
Oh dear, oh dear.\nHelp me, please!
He's so helpless, he needed\nsomeone like me to look after him.
TEAM ROCKET is trying to conquer\nthe world with POKéMON.
TEAM ROCKET ran away, and it's all\nbecause of you!
They must have targeted SILPH for\nour POKéMON products.
Come work for SILPH when you\nget older.
I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!
No matter!\nMy brothers will avenge me!
That rotten PRESIDENT!\fServes him right for shipping me\noff to the TIKSI BRANCH!\fThat's why TEAM ROCKET came after\nus, I'm sure of it!
If you stand for justice, you\nbetray us bad guys!
Oh! Hi! You're not a ROCKET!\nYou came to save us?\pWhy, thank you!\fI want you to have this POKéMON\nfor saving us.
{FD01} obtained a LAPRAS from\nthe SILPH employee!

It's a LAPRAS.
It's a very intelligent POKéMON. We kept it in our lab, but it will
be much better off with you. I think you will be a good TRAINER
for LAPRAS! It's a good swimmer.
It'll give you a lift across water!
TEAM ROCKET's BOSS went to the\nboardroom!\fIs our PRESIDENT okay?\nI'm worried.
TEAM ROCKET was after the MASTER\nBALL, which catches any POKéMON.
We canceled the MASTER BALL\nproject because of TEAM ROCKET.
It would be bad if TEAM ROCKET\ntook over SILPH or our POKéMON.
Wow!\fYou chased off TEAM ROCKET all by\nyourself?
You!\nIt's really dangerous here!\fYou came to save me?\nYou can't!
You won't find my BOSS by just\nscurrying around!
Heheh!\fYou mistook me for a SILPH worker?
Despite your age, you are a\nskilled TRAINER!
I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!
Doesn't matter.\nMy brothers will repay the favor!
A child intruder?\nThat must be you!
Go on home before my BOSS gets\nticked off!

{FD06}: Hahaha! I thought you'd
turn up if I waited here! I guess TEAM ROCKET slowed you
down! Not that I care! I saw you in SAFFRON, so I decided
to see if you got better!
Oh, man!\nSo, you are ready for BOSS\pROCKET!

Well, {FD01}!
I'm moving on up and ahead! By checking my POKéDEX, I'm
starting to see what's strong and\phow they evolve! Am I a genius or what? I'm going to the POKéMON LEAGUE to
boot out the ELITE FOUR. I'll become the world's most
powerful TRAINER! {FD01}, well, good luck to you!
Don't sweat it!\pSmell ya!
That's as far as you'll go!
So, what do you think of SILPH\nBUILDING's maze?
I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!
I'll leave you up to my brothers.
You look tired.\nYou should take a quick nap.
Your POKéMON seem to adore you,\nkid!
Your POKéMON have weak points!\nI can nail them!
Exploiting weak spots does work.\nThink about type advantages.
I am one of the four ROCKET\nBROTHERS!
Welcome to 10F!\nSo good of you to join me!
Nice try, but the boardroom is up\none more floor.
Are you satisfied with beating me?\nThen go on home!

PRESIDENT: Oh, dear boy!
Thank you for saving SILPH. I will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril. I have to thank you in some way. Because I am rich, I can give you
anything. Here, maybe this will do.

PRESIDENT: Oh, dear girl!
Thank you for saving SILPH. I will never forget you saved us in
our moment of peril. I have to thank you in some way. Because I am rich, I can give you
anything. Here, maybe this will do.
{FD01} obtained a MASTER BALL\nfrom the PRESIDENT!

PRESIDENT: You can't buy that
anywhere. It's our secret prototype MASTER
BALL. It will catch any POKéMON without
fail! You should be quiet about using it,
though.
You have no room for this.
SECRETARY: Thank you for rescuing\nall of us.\fWe, from the PRESIDENT down,\nare indebted to you.
Blast it all!\nYou ruined our plans for SILPH!\fBut, TEAM ROCKET will never fall!\f{FD01}! Never forget that all\nPOKéMON exist for TEAM ROCKET!\fI must go, but I shall return!
So, you want to see my BOSS?
Halt! Do you have an appointment\nwith my BOSS?
The monitor has POKéMON on it!
Who are you?\nThere shouldn't be anyone here.
A key? I don't know what you're\ntalking about.
W-w-waah! You startled me!\nI thought you were a ghost.
I was exploring here by myself,\nbut I feel spooked.\fI ought to go soon.
I can't get out!\nThis old place is one big puzzle.
The switches here open and close\nalternating sets of doors.
Diary: July 5\nGuyana, South America\fA new POKéMON was discovered deep\nin the jungle.
Diary: July 10\nWe christened the newly discovered\pPOKéMON, MEW.
I wonder where my partner went.
So, you're stuck?\nTry jumping off over there!
Diary: Feb. 6\nMEW gave birth.\fWe named the newborn MEWTWO.
You can find stuff lying around.\nThe residents must've left them.
This place is ideal for a lab.\nLook at all this space.
I like it here.\nIt's conducive to my studies.
TRAINER TIPS\fPress START to check\nremaining time.
TRAINER TIPS\fThe remaining time declines only\nwhile you walk.
TRAINER TIPS\fThe SECRET HOUSE is still ahead.
TRAINER TIPS\fPOKéMON hide in tall grass.\fZigzag through grassy areas to\nflush them out.
TRAINER TIPS\fWin a free HM for finding the\nSECRET HOUSE.
REQUEST NOTICE\fPlease find the SAFARI WARDEN's\nlost GOLD TEETH.\pThey're around here somewhere.\fReward offered!\nContact: WARDEN
TRAINER TIPS\fZone Exploration Campaign!\nThe Search for the SECRET HOUSE!
SARA: Where did my boyfriend,\nERIK, go?
I'm catching POKéMON to take home\nas gifts.
How many did you catch?\nI'm bushed from the effort!
I caught a CHANSEY!\fThat makes this all worthwhile.
Whew!\nI'm tired from all the fun!
You can keep any item you find in\nthe SAFARI ZONE.\fBut, you'll run out of time if you\ntry for all of them at once.
Go to the deepest part of the\nSAFARI ZONE. You will win a prize!
My EEVEE evolved into FLAREON.\fBut, a friend's EEVEE turned into a\nVAPOREON. I wonder why?

The SAFARI ZONE's huge, wouldn't
you say? FUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA, 
patrols the grounds every so often. Thanks to him, we can play here
knowing that we're safe.
Tossing ROCKS at POKéMON might\nmake them run, but they'll be\peasier to catch.
Using BAIT will make POKéMON more\nlikely to stick around if they get\pbusy eating.
I hiked a lot, but I didn't see any\nPOKéMON I wanted.

Ah! Finally! You're the first person to reach
the SECRET HOUSE! Although I made a campaign
for our grand opening, I was getting worried that no one
would win our campaign prize. Congratulations!
You have won!

HM03 is SURF. POKéMON will be able to ferry you
across water using it. And, this HM isn't disposable, so
you can use it over and over. You're super lucky for winning this
fabulous prize!
You don't have room for this\nfabulous prize!
You're better than I thought.\nGo on ahead.\fYou only got a taste of the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE's power.
My job is done.\nGo face your next challenge.
You win!\fI see what the old duff sees in\nyou now.\fI have nothing else to say.\nRun along now, child!
That's it!\fI hate to admit it, but you are a\nPOKéMON master!

NO!
That can't be!\pYou beat me at my best! After all that work to become
the LEAGUE CHAMP? My reign is over already?
It's not fair!

OAK: So, you've won!
Sincerely, congratulations! You're the new POKéMON LEAGUE
CHAMPION! You've grown up so much since you
first left with {FD02} to work\pon the POKéDEX. {FD01}, you have come of age!

OAK: {FD01}. You understand that your victory
was not just your own doing. The bond you share with your
POKéMON is marvelous. {FD01}!
Come with me!

OAK: Er-hem!
Congratulations, {FD01}! This floor is the POKéMON HALL OF
FAME. POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPIONS are
honored for their exploits here. Their POKéMON are also recorded in
the HALL OF FAME. {FD01}! You have worked hard to become
the new LEAGUE CHAMPION. Congratulations, {FD01}, you and
your POKéMON are HALL OF FAMERS!
This tunnel goes a long way, kid!
Watch for ONIX.\nThey appear only occasionally.\fHigh-level ones can put the\nsqueeze on you!
Ease up!\nWhat am I doing?\pWhich way is out?
That sleeping POKéMON on ROUTE 12\nforced me to take this detour.
Outsiders like you need to show me\nsome respect!
Oh well, I'll get a ZUBAT as I go!
Eek!\fDon't try anything funny in the\ndark!
I saw a MACHOP in this tunnel.
I came this far looking for wild\nPOKéMON.
You looked cute and harmless.\nWas I ever wrong!
Do you know how you can avoid\ngetting lost in the mountains?\fYou can bend twigs as trail\nmarkers.
I go for power because I hate\nthinking.
You have a POKéDEX?\nI want one, too.
When you finish your POKéDEX,\ncan I have it?
POKéMON cosplay is dressing up as\nPOKéMON for fun.\fCLEFAIRY is a favorite.
My POKéMON techniques will leave\nyou crying!
In mountains, you'll often find\nROCK-type POKéMON.
I don't often come here, but I will\nbattle you.
I like tiny POKéMON.\nBig ones are too scary!
Hit me with your best shot!
I'll raise my POKéMON to beat\nyours, kid.
I draw illustrations of POKéMON\nwhen I'm home.
I'm an artist, not a fighter.\nI'll go home to draw.

When you're up on a rocky mountain
like this, rockslides are a threat. Can you imagine?
Boulders tumbling down on you? That'd be, like, waaaaaaaaaaah!
Total terror! You don't seem to be scared.
Want to try using ROCK SLIDE?
Oh, so you are scared after all.
Which POKéMON should I teach\nROCK SLIDE?
Hint: Boulders might change the\nflow of water.
POKéMON TOWER was erected in the\nmemory of POKéMON that died.
Did you come to pay respects?\fBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\nson.
Did you come to pay respects?\fBless your POKéMON-loving heart,\ngirl.
I am a CHANNELER.\fThere are spirits up to mischief.\nI sense them high in the TOWER.
{FD06}: Hey, {FD01}!\nWhat brings you here?\pIs your POKéMON dead?\fHey! It's alive!\fI can at least make them faint!\nLet's go!
What?\nYou stinker!\fI took it easy on you, too!

How's your POKéDEX coming?
I just caught a CUBONE! I can't find the bigger MAROWAK.
Where could they be? I bet there aren't any left! Well, I better get going.
I've got a lot to accomplish,\punlike you. Smell ya later!
Even we could not identify the\nwayward ghosts.\fA SILPH SCOPE might be able to\nunmask them.
The ghosts can be identified by\nthe SILPH SCOPE.
Come, child!\nI have purified this space.\pYou can rest here.
Entered the purified and protected\nzone.\f{FD01}'s POKéMON were fully\nhealed.
My hair didn't fall out!\nIt was a malevolent spirit!
The ghost was the restless spirit\nof CUBONE's mother!
What do you want?\nWhy are you here?
I'm not going to forget this!

This old guy marched right up to
our HIDEOUT. Then, he starts ranting about how
TEAM ROCKET's abusing POKéMON. So, we're just talking it over as
adults.
POKéMON are only good for making\nmoney. Why not use them?\fYou stay out of our business!
You're not getting away with this!

MR. FUJI: Heh?
You came to save me? Thank you. But, I came here of my
own free will. I came to calm the spirit of
CUBONE's mother. I think MAROWAK's spirit has
finally left us. I must thank you for your kind
concern. Follow me to my home, POKéMON
HOUSE, at the foot of this tower.

Can you imagine?
If this volcano were to erupt? The explosion would be the end of
us. How terrifying is that? While we're terrified, would you
like me to teach EXPLOSION?
Yeah, you're right.\nIt is too terrifying.
You're terribly brave!\fWhich POKéMON should I teach\nEXPLOSION?
Over here.\nWe'll try digging here.\fThat treasure the ADMINS've been\ntalking about should be here.
Whew, punched through at last.\nLet's go treasure hunting!
You've been eavesdropping on us,\nhaven't you?
Trying to horn in on our treasure?\nDon't bet on it!
Develop amnesia conveniently and\nforget everything you heard!
An active volcano is one that's\nerupting, or about to.
They say there're over 1,500\nactive volcanoes in the world.\fJust thinking about them makes me\nfeel all hot and gooey inside!
Do you know how caves form inside\nvolcanoes?
When lava at the surface of magma\nhardens, and the magma inside flows\pout, caverns are left behind.
Oh! Here it comes again!\nNo! Go away! It's scaring me!\fWaaaaaaah!\nI want my daddy!
Ohh! That was so scary!\nThank you!\fLOSTELLE came to pick some\nBERRIES.\fYou can have this!
What's your name?\fLOSTELLE's scared, so can I go\nwith you to my daddy's house?\fOkay!\nLet's go home!
Your BERRY POUCH is full.\nI guess you don't want this.
Welcome to the BERRY FOREST\fBe friendly and share BERRIES with\nothers and POKéMON.
LORELEI: Keep your filthy hands\noff the POKéMON in the cave!\fDo as I say, or you'll have me to\nanswer to!
Aww, shut it, lady, and leave\nus be.\fDon't let your glasses get all\nsteamed up!

LORELEI: {FD01}?!
What are you doing here? No, we can catch up later.
Right now, I need your help. Help me kick these poachers out
before they do anything else. They've been catching POKéMON
here, then selling them off! Are you ready?
You take that one, please!
W-what?!\fWho says we can't do what we want\nwith the POKéMON we catch?

LORELEI: Humph.
So despicably weak. You!
Tell me! Where have you taken the captured
POKéMON? I'm smashing your ring once and
for all!
N-no way!\nI'm not telling you that!
The pen door is unlocked.\nThe POKéMON appear to have fled.
Did you come here knowing it's\nTEAM ROCKET's WAREHOUSE?
What do you think you're doing?!
TEAM ROCKET broke up?\nWhat planet are you from?

{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}Hi, I'm excavating for fossils here\nunder MT. MOON.\fSometimes, BROCK of PEWTER GYM\nlends me a hand.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0102}{FC0303}BROCK rarely laughs, but is said to\nbe unable to stop if he starts.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do?\f{FC0102}{FC0303}CERULEAN CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: MISTY\pThe Tomboyish Mermaid!
{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}My policy is an all-out offensive\nwith WATER-type POKéMON!
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}MISTY is a TRAINER who's going to\nkeep improving.\fShe won't lose to someone like you!
{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do?\f{FC0102}{FC0303}VERMILION CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: LT. SURGE\pThe Lightning American!
{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}I tell you, kid, electric POKéMON\nsaved me during the war!
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}When I was in the Army, LT. SURGE\nwas my strict CO.\fHe was a hard taskmaster.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}LT. SURGE was always famous for\nhis cautious nature in the Army.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}LT. SURGE installed the traps in\nthe GYM himself.\fHe set up double locks everywhere.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do?\f{FC0102}{FC0303}CELADON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ERIKA\pThe Nature-Loving Princess!
{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}I am a student of the art of\nflower arranging.\fMy POKéMON are solely of the\nGRASS type.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}Our LEADER ERIKA might be quiet,\nbut she's famous around here.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}We only use GRASS-type POKéMON at\nour GYM.\fWhy? We also use them for making\nflower arrangements!
{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}I would never collect POKéMON if\nthey were unattractive.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do?\f{FC0102}{FC0303}FUCHSIA CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: KOGA\pThe Poisonous Ninja Master
{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}Despair to the creeping horror of\nPOISON-type POKéMON!
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}Even though I've lost, I will keep\ntraining according to the teachings\pof KOGA, my ninja master.
{FC0108}{FC0309}Family and friends?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}My father is the GYM LEADER of\nthis town.\fI'm training to use POISON POKéMON\nas well as my father.

{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do? {FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}The SAFARI ZONE's huge, wouldn't
you say? FUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA, 
patrols the grounds every so often. Thanks to him, we can play here
knowing that we're safe.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do?\f{FC0102}{FC0303}SAFFRON CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SABRINA\pThe Master of PSYCHIC POKéMON!
{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}You know about a girl GYM LEADER\nin SAFFRON CITY?\fShe uses PSYCHIC-type POKéMON,\nright?
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}I have had psychic powers since\nI was a child.\fIt started when a spoon I\ncarelessly tossed, bent.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}I dislike battling, but if you wish,\nI will show you my powers!
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}SABRINA just wiped out the KARATE\nMASTER next door.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do?\f{FC0102}{FC0303}CINNABAR ISLAND POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BLAINE\pThe Hotheaded Quiz Master!
{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}My fiery POKéMON are all rough\nand ready with intense heat!\fThey incinerate all challengers!

{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON? {FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost
in the mountains but good. Night fell when a fiery bird
POKéMON appeared. Its light allowed BLAINE to find
his way down safely.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE is quite the\nodd fellow.\fHe's lived on the island since way\nbefore the LAB was built.
{FC0108}{FC0309}Family and friends?\f{FC0102}{FC0303}It's a photo of BLAINE and\nMR. FUJI.\fThey're standing shoulder to\nshoulder with big grins.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}I am LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR.
{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}No one can best me when it comes\nto icy POKéMON.
{FC0108}{FC0309}Where was this person born?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}We've had a great and powerful\nTRAINER grow up on this island.\fI bet even you'd know her.\nIt's LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR!
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0102}{FC0303}Known for her logical, calculated,\nand cool battling style, LORELEI\phas a surprising secret!
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}Did you know that LORELEI has lots\nand lots of stuffed dolls?\fEvery time she comes back to\nFOUR ISLAND, her collection grows!

{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON? {FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}The LAPRAS she has, I imagine it
to be the one she met as a child. I believe it was in ICEFALL CAVE
that she caught it. Perhaps that POKéMON has been with
her ever since.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!
{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}I've lived and trained with my\nfighting POKéMON!
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0102}{FC0303}BRUNO apparently joined the ELITE\nFOUR out of his burning ambition to\pbattle the best TRAINERS.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}BRUNO, who's a senior ahead of me,\nvisits the SPA on occasion.\fHe comes to rehab injuries, both\nhis own and his POKéMON's.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.
{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}AGATHA's GHOST-type POKéMON are\nhorrifically terrifying in toughness.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}That old lady's also got a really\nshort fuse, too.\fIt doesn't take anything to get\nthat scary lady hollering.

{FC0108}{FC0309}Family and friends? {FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}I hear OAK's taken a lot of
interest in you, child. That old duff was once tough and
handsome. But that was decades ago.
He's a shadow of his former self.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}Take AGATHA, for example.\fShe set a record for being the\noldest-ever ELITE FOUR member.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}I lead the ELITE FOUR.\fYou can call me LANCE the dragon\nTRAINER.

{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON? {FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}You know that dragons are
mythical POKéMON. They're hard to catch and raise,
but their powers are superior. They're virtually indestructible.
There's no being clever with them.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}He stands for justice!\nHe's cool, and yet passionate!\pHe's the greatest, LANCE!
{FC0108}{FC0309}Family and friends?\f{FC0102}{FC0303}LANCE's grandfather is thought to\nbe the elder of a famous clan of\pdragon masters.
{FC0108}{FC0309}Family and friends?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}From what I've heard, LANCE has\na cousin who's a GYM LEADER\psomewhere far away.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}After all, BILL's world-famous as a\nPOKéMANIAC.\fHe invented the POKéMON Storage\nSystem on PC, too.
{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}BILL has lots of POKéMON!\nHe collects rare ones, too!
{FC0108}{FC0309}What is this person like?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}He's my grandson!\fHe always liked collecting things,\neven as a child!
{FC0108}{FC0309}Favorite kind of POKéMON?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}BILL is a POKéMANIAC, so he loves\nevery kind.\fApparently, the first one he caught\nwas an ABRA.
{FC0108}{FC0309}Family and friends?\f{FC0604}{FC0102}{FC0303}BILL's hometown is GOLDENROD CITY,\nwhere his folks still live.\fI've heard that it's quite the\nfestive, bustling city.
{FC0108}{FC0309}What does this person do?\f{FC0605}{FC0102}{FC0303}He's really kind.\fHe looks after abandoned and\norphaned POKéMON.

You become the main character,\nexploring the world of POKéMON.\pBy talking to people and solving\pmysteries, new paths will open to you.\pStrive for the goal together with your\pwonderful POKéMON.

When you come across another person,\ngo up to them and press the A Button.\pThat will get them to talk and interact\pwith your character. You may also\pexamine various items and objects in\pthe same way. Talk to people and check\pthings often to obtain information.
On the stairs or the exits of a\nbuilding is a red mat. Move your\pcharacter to stand on top of the\pred mat. Press the {F904} Control Pad \ptoward the stairs or the exit to\padvance.
This isn't something you should worry\nabout too much.\pTalk to other people, check signs,\pcheck things, and so on.\pSometimes, you may need to just move\pto a new town or place.
Try moving on to a new road, town, or\nplace.

There could be something in the town\nor inside a building that is the cause.\pTry talking to the people in the area\pagain. If there is a problem that they\pneed solved, you may have to help.\pAfterwards, try talking to the person\pblocking your way again.

Try talking to people by going up to\nthem and pressing the A Button.\pAlso, try checking things like odd trees\pand strange rocks with the A Button.\pPress the {F904} Control Pad and try going\pto places that look impassable, too.
Try going to places where you \nhaven't visited yet.\pAlso, check everything that looks\psuspicious by pressing the A Button.

If POKéMON are hurt in battle,\ntake them to a POKéMON CENTER and\phave them healed by the staff.\pGet in the habit of saving your\pgame and recording your progress.\pStock up on healing items at\pPOKéMON MARTS before traveling far.
Forests are basically the same as\nroads but they can be like mazes.\pAll forests have a way out, so don't\pgive up if you get lost.

Caves are dark and dangerous. Wild\nPOKéMON can appear anywhere in them.\pIf there is an emergency, rush to a\pPOKéMON CENTER or use items.\pNew towns await discovery beyond some\pcaves, so don't give up.

The object of the game is to train\nyour POKéMON and move forward.\pYou must collect info and solve\pproblems. For example, what do you\pneed to get around an obstacle?\pWhat would get that impeding\pperson out of the way?
There are several kinds of items.\nSome can be used only on the field.\pSome are only for use during battle.\pSome can be used anytime.\pTry using an item - if it can't be used,\pyou will be alerted.

In a battle, POKéMON try to reduce\none another's vitality, expressed as\pHP. If a POKéMON's HP falls to zero,\pit faints, and the other POKéMON\pwins. By winning a battle, POKéMON\pearn EXP. Points, which help them\plevel up «grow stronger).
First, fully heal the POKéMON in your\nparty «the POKéMON with you) at any\pPOKéMON CENTER.\pYou should also buy healing items for\pemergencies at a POKéMON MART.

A POKéMON's vitality is expressed in HP.\nIf a POKéMON is hurt in battle, HP is\psubtracted. If its HP drops to zero,\pthe POKéMON faints.\pHeal hurt or fainted POKéMON at a\pPOKéMON CENTER or by using items.

A POKéMON CENTER is like an inn for\nPOKéMON. It will fully heal POKéMON of\pany status problems and fully restore\ptheir HP using a special machine.\pThis service is free, so get in the\phabit of healing your POKéMON often.

A status problem refers to an ailment\nthat is inflicted on a POKéMON by its\pfoe's attack. These include burns,\pparalysis, poisoning, sleep, and\pfreezing. These can be healed by\pvisiting a POKéMON CENTER or using\pthe appropriate item.

If all the POKéMON in your party\n«all the POKéMON with you) faint, you\plose some MONEY, and you are\preturned home or to a POKéMON\pCENTER. To reduce that chance, visit\pPOKéMON CENTERS often. Also, get\pin the habit of saving often.

If a wild POKéMON escapes from a POKé\nBALL, it's obviously still feisty.\pTry reducing its HP some more, and\ptry to weaken it with paralysis or sleep\pbefore trying to catch it.\pIf the POKé BALL rocks for a while,\pthe quarry is close to being caught!

There are shops, known as POKéMON\nMARTS, that sell items.\pYou will not find POKéMON MARTS on\proads, in forests, or in caves.\pStock up on needed items while you are\pvisiting a town with a POKéMON MART.

You may buy POKé BALLS at any\nPOKéMON MART in any town.\pYou will not find POKéMON MARTS on\proads, in forests, or in caves.\pStock up on POKé BALLS while you are\pvisiting a town with a POKéMON MART.

A TRAINER is a person who raises\nPOKéMON through battling.\pTRAINERS will challenge you \pwherever they are - it could be on\pa road, in forests, caves, anywhere.\pIf your eyes meet, you have to accept\ptheir challenge. So be careful!

To beat a TRAINER in battle, use\nPOKéMON that have type advantages\pover the foe's POKéMON. You may also\puse highly trained POKéMON with\poverwhelming power. Outnumbering the\pfoe's POKéMON is another obvious\ptactic.
Wild POKéMON will appear in tall grass,\non roads, and in forests. They will\pappear anywhere in dark caves.\pThere are no wild POKéMON or TRAINERS\pin towns, so they are safe places.

POKéMON may learn up to four different\ntechniques, or moves. There is a great\pvariety of moves including attacks and\pthose with special effects. The kinds\pof moves that can be learned vary\pfor each POKéMON. Some moves\pcan be learned from machines.

The most a POKéMON can learn is four\nmoves. They are learned as the\pPOKéMON levels up. It can also be\ptaught a move using a TM «Technical\pMachine) or HM «Hidden Machine).\pThere are also people who teach moves.

The key to making your POKéMON\nstrong is to battle and win often.\pThe EXP. «Experience) Points earned\pby winning battles accumulate to\plevel up POKéMON that participated in\pthem. Battle wild POKéMON often to\plevel up your party.

If your foes are too strong, try\nleveling up your POKéMON some more.\pGo back the way you came and battle\pwild POKéMON to level up your party.\pYou may also battle TRAINERS whom you\phave not battled before.

Unlike roads and forests, wild POKéMON\ncan appear anywhere in caves.\pIf your POKéMON are hurt in a cave,\prush to a POKéMON CENTER or use items\pto heal them right away. It is very\pdangerous to force your luck in caves.
Trust your own knowledge and power.\nBelieve in yourself and find your way!
POKéMON are living beings about which\nmany mysteries still remain. You may\psee them in grass, the sea, and caves.\pThey appear to obey the wishes of the\pTRAINERS that caught them.
Use the FAME CHECKER among the\nKEY ITEMS in your BAG.\pIt may give you a hint, so try it out.

A HIDDEN move is taught to a POKéMON\nusing an HM «Hidden Machine).\pA HIDDEN move is important for helping\pyour adventure. For example, one is\pused to light up dark caves. Another\pcuts down small trees. There is one\pfor traveling on water, and so on.
Try to catch wild POKéMON by throwing\nthe special SAFARI BALLS.\pYou may keep any item you find, too.
Your SAFARI GAME ends once you have\ntraveled a certain distance or thrown\pall your SAFARI BALLS.\pOpen the MENU to check the remaining\pnumber of steps and SAFARI BALLS.

POKéMON GYMS are operated by the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE and are training\pfacilities for TRAINERS. They are all\pacross the land in cities and towns.\pEach one is headed by a LEADER, who\pis a very skilled TRAINER. Beat the\pLEADER to collect a BADGE.
Using a move outside of battle

HP indicates a POKéMON's vitality.\nIf a POKéMON's HP drops to zero, it\pfaints and is unable to battle.\pSo, the key in battle is to try to\preduce the foe's HP to zero.\pIf your POKéMON are hurt, restore their\pHP at a POKéMON CENTER or use items.

POKéMON may learn up to four different\nmoves. There are many kinds of moves\pincluding attacks and those with\pspecial effects. The kinds of moves\pthat can be learned vary for each\pPOKéMON. Some moves can be learned\pfrom items.

ATTACK indicates the power of an\noffensive move. The higher this stat,\pthe more powerful the move.\pIt is applied for the following move\ptypes: NORMAL, POISON, GROUND,\pFLYING, BUG, FIGHTING, ROCK, GHOST,\pand STEEL.
DEFENSE indicates the resistance a\nPOKéMON has against physical attacks.\pThe higher this stat, the less damage\psustained from a foe's physical hit.

SP. ATK «Special Attack) indicates the\npower of a special attack move.\pThe higher this stat, the more powerful\pthe special attack move.\pIt is applied for the following move\ptypes: FIRE, WATER, ELECTRIC, GRASS,\pICE, PSYCHIC, DRAGON, and DARK.
SP. DEF «Special Defense) indicates\nthe resistance a POKéMON has against\pspecial attacks.\pThe higher this stat, the less damage\psustained from a foe's special attack.
SPEED indicates the agility of a\nPOKéMON. If this stat exceeds the foe's\pin battle, the POKéMON can make a move\pbefore its slower opponent.

Lv. «Level) indicates the growth and\nstrength of a POKéMON.\pIn general, when a POKéMON levels up,\pits stats such as HP, ATTACK, and\pDEFENSE rise, making it stronger.\pPOKéMON may learn a new move upon\pleveling up.

POKéMON and moves are classified by\ntype. Every type has advantageous and\pdisadvantageous matchups against\pother types. For example, like a rock-\ppaper-scissors game, the WATER type is\pstrong against the FIRE type and weak\pagainst the GRASS type.

All POKéMON have a special ABILITY.\nThere are many different kinds of these\pabilities, some used in battle, some\pelsewhere. The abilities differ from\pspecies to species. Some species may\phave more than one kind of ability.
Whenever you win a battle against a\nTRAINER, you are given prize money.\pSave up your prize money so you can\penjoy shopping at POKéMON MARTS!

Moves are also classified by types.\nIf a POKéMON of a certain type uses\pa move of the same type, the move's\ppower is boosted. If the move's type\phas a matchup advantage against the\ptarget, its effectiveness is also\pboosted.

The ID No. is a special number assigned\nspecifically to you as a TRAINER.\pTogether with the OT name, the ID No.\pis used to precisely identify the\pOriginal TRAINER.\pThe ID No. does not change even if the\pPOKéMON is traded.
POWER indicates the strength of an\nattack. The higher this number, the\pgreater the damage that can be\pinflicted on the foe!
ACCURACY indicates the probability of\nthe move hitting the foe.\pThe higher this number, the more likely\pthe move will strike the target.
Ordinary items bought at any POKéMON\nMART are placed in the ITEMS POCKET.\pItems may be used, given to a POKéMON\pto hold, or tossed out as garbage.

Important items that you find or \nreceive from people are placed in the\pKEY ITEMS POCKET.\pKey items may be used, or registered\pfor use instantly with SELECT. Once\pregistered, the item can be used\pwithout opening the MENU and BAG.

POKé BALLS, which are used for\ncatching wild POKéMON, are placed in\pthe POKé BALLS POCKET.\pPOKé BALLS may be bought at POKéMON\pMARTS. They may be used, given to a\pPOKéMON to hold, or tossed out as\pgarbage.
This indicates the number of species of\nPOKéMON you have caught and/or\pevolved to fill the POKéDEX.\pTry hard to catch all sorts of\pPOKéMON!
This is the total amount of time that\nyou have played this game.
The POKéMON LEAGUE BADGES that you\nhave won are registered and shown.\pEarn BADGES by defeating GYM LEADERS\pin various cities and towns.
You can adjust how quickly the text is\ndisplayed. Choose one: SLOW, MID,\por FAST.
You can choose to turn the battle\nanimation ON or OFF.
You can choose between MONO and\nSTEREO sound output.
You may choose the design of the frame\naround certain menus. Try them out and\psee what you like.
The settings will be changed to the\nselections shown in red, and you will\preturn to the MENU.

A TM «Technical Machine) is a device\nused to teach a move to a POKéMON.\pThere are many different kinds.\pMoves can be taught only to those\pPOKéMON capable of using them.\pA TM breaks after a single use.

An HM «Hidden Machine) is a device used\nto teach a HIDDEN move to a POKéMON.\pA HIDDEN move can be taught only to\pthose POKéMON capable of using it.\pUnlike a TM, an HM can be used over\pand over. A HIDDEN move can be tough\pfor a POKéMON to forget.

Among POKéMON, there are some that\nundergo major changes «evolution) upon\pgrowing to certain levels. Evolution\pcauses a POKéMON to alter form, change\pits name, and perhaps change the moves\pit may learn. Some POKéMON evolve\pdue to reasons other than leveling up.

Status problems include:\nSleep: Can't use moves.\pPoison: Causes steady HP loss.\pParalysis: May prevent moves.\pBurn: HP loss and lowers ATTACK.\pFreeze: Can't use moves.\pThese can be healed with items, etc.
POKéMON is a name given to describe\nwondrous creatures that inhabit all\pcorners of this world.\pPeople raise POKéMON to be their pets,\puse them for battling, and so on.

The ID No. is a special number assigned\nspecifically to you as a TRAINER.\pTogether with the OT name, the ID No.\pis used to precisely identify the\pOriginal TRAINER.\pThe ID No. does not change even if the\pPOKéMON is traded.
Whenever you win a battle against a\nTRAINER, you are given prize money.\pSave up your prize money so you can\penjoy shopping at POKéMON MARTS!
This indicates the number of POKéMON\nLEAGUE BADGES that you have won.\pEarn BADGES by defeating GYM LEADERS\pin various cities and towns.

The help messages change depending on\nhow much you have progressed in the\pgame. They are designed to support you\pwhen you need them. If there is\panything that you don't understand,\pplease look up the HELP System!
You become the main character to\nexplore the world of POKéMON!\pBy talking to people and solving\pmysteries, new paths will open to you.\pStrive for the goal together with your\pwonderful POKéMON!

This game communicates over a wireless
link using the Wireless Adapter. Go wireless anywhere, anytime, and
with anybody! Try playing with the Wireless Adapter
always attached!
Visit every city and town, travel every\nroad, explore every cave, and face\pevery challenge as you strive to\pbecome the greatest TRAINER of\pPOKéMON!

On your adventure, you will be faced\nwith many obstacles. Every obstacle\pcan be overcome by doing something\por by solving mysteries. Some obstacles\pare affected by something that happens\pfar away.
Some of the obstacles in your way can\nbe removed once your POKéMON learn\pspecific moves.
